column3: oṁ śāstrāṇy adhītya medhāvī abhyasya ca punaḥ punaḥ |
oṁkāraṁ ratham āruhya viṣṇuṁ kṛtvā tu sārathim |
tāvad rathena gantavyaṁ yāvad rathapathi sthitaḥ |
asvareṇa makāreṇa padaṁ sūkṣmaṁ ca gacchati ||
cintayed ātmano raśmīn pratyāhāraḥ sa ucyate ||
tarkaś caiva samādhiś ca ṣaḍaṅgo yoga ucyate ||
